build_object_detector: build a CenterNetDetector object detector using detectron2 config to detect objects in images
run_inference: run inference on batched input images using the CenterNetDetector to get object detection results
train_detector: train the CenterNetDetector by calling forward with batched inputs containing ground truth instances
preprocess_images: preprocess input images by normalizing, padding, and batching them for the CenterNetDetector backbone
review_detector_architecture: review the CenterNetDetector class and its backbone and proposal generator components
